QuestInfo.name: [Magatia's Secret] The Black Mage's Pentacle
QuestInfo.1:
#p2020005# says that #p2111002#'s experiments caused the Black Mage's pentacle to destabilize. It could destroy #m261000000#. You must take the #bthree magic stones and put them in place in the correct order to stabilize the pentacles, then activate the central pentacle#k.  

#i4031739# #t4031739# #b#c4031739##k/1 
#i4031740# #t4031740# #b#c4031740##k/1 
#i4031741# #t4031741# #b#c4031741##k/1

Take the magic stones to the Black Mage's research lab, through #m261030000# between the Zenumist and Alcadno institutes.

You can get to #m261030000# through the closed doors in #b#m261010000##k and #b#m261020200##k.
QuestInfo.2: After successfully putting Magic Pentagram under control, I went to see #p2020005#, the 3rd president of the Alchemist Union, again. I wonder what he's thinking, with that soothing smile that instinctively makes us put our guards down...?

0.0: Yes, #r#m261000000# is a town built right above the lab of the Black Mage#k. That's the truth, yet most residents of #m261000000# aren't even aware of it...\r\n#b#L0# Can you explain a little bit more on it?#l
0.1: Yes I will... but before that, I want to clarify something first. As written on the note, did #p2111002# wind up conducting the experiment? \r\n#b#L0# Yes, he did.#l
0.2: ...*sigh* In that case, I have no choice but to give you some of the burden in regards to this event. The experiments conducted by #p2111002# were too risky and reckless, to say the least. He may have believed in the power of the Black Mage, but... the pentacle he made was made hundreds of years ago. It's probably already weakened considerably since then. \r\n#b#L0# That means...#l
0.3: If #p2111002#'s experiment is the cause for the epic explosion, then I am sure the Black Mage's Magic Pentagram is destroyed as well. The fact that the Magic Pentagram served as the foundation of #m261000000#, and if that's destroyed... you get the picture. I suspect that after #p2111002#'s failure, #m261000000# itself might have been negatively affected. Isn't that so? \r\n#b#L0# I heard that was the case.#l
0.4: ...I knew it. In that case... I may need to give you more responsibilities on this matter. Can you do something important for the town of #m261000000#? The town that is polluted with lies and deceit?

yes.0: Good. I want you to take these magic stones with you. These are the three magic stones that have been extracted from the pentacle made by the Black Mage. I want you to place them in the pentacle.
yes.1: With this much power... those three should be enough to stabilize Black Mage's pentacle.
yes.2: You'll need to activate the #btop Magic Pentagram, left Magic Pentagram, and the right Magic Pentagram in that order#k, followed by applying pressure on the center of the Magic Pentagram. This should aid the Magic Pentagram in stabilizing its power, which means you are holding the key to the future of #m261000000#! Good luck...

no.0: Even if you reject the offer, there's no turning back. #m261000000#...may not even be worth that.

1.0: You managed to activate Black Mage's Magic Pentagram. Thank you so much for your help. I believe that with your great deed, #m261000000# will finally be back in peace. That said...

yes.0: Hmm...I don't know. I've spent hundreds of years living here, but I still can't make the decision on what to do with #m261000000#...
